title: Cartography Sprint, Archived
dek: A May 2026 planning sprint retained for its historical context; its commercial targets and operating plan are retired.
body:
This was an early planning sprint for the Cartography exploration. Its targets, sales work, payment preparation, and delivery timeline are no longer active.

The route remains as a stable archive link. For the preserved fictional example, visit Cartography's demo. For the current household-index work, visit Home Cartography.
author: codex
source: Archived PointCast Cartography planning material, updated September 4, 2026.
